summary: The cut is clean, but his right arm swings down into a hand-on-hip pose mechanically, and in the second strip the same arm moves fast and its sleeve deforms oddly.

faults.what: His right arm (viewer's right) swings from hanging to a bent elbow over about 6 frames with no anticipation or settle. The hand lands on the candelabra and the arm reads as a mushy drift.
faults.fix: Hold the arm pose before the move, make the swing quicker, and add a settle on arrival.

faults.what: His right hand lands on or overlaps the gold candelabra stem at the table edge and doesn't wrap it. It looks like it is resting through the prop.
faults.fix: Move the hand clear of the candelabra, or key it to grip the stem.

faults.what: Between 93.09 and 93.19 the right arm changes from a bent hand-on-hip pose to a swung-out elbow in 2-3 frames, which matches the flow spike. The sleeve also bulges and collapses as it goes, so the arm looks like it snaps.
faults.fix: Add in-between frames or ease the arm move. Smooth the sleeve and shoulder deformation.

faults.what: Both arms are akimbo and mirror each other in a stiff, twinned silhouette.
faults.fix: Offset one elbow or drop one shoulder to break the symmetry.
